message.content: {"rephrased_statement": "Wikileaks, a whistleblowing website, published a leaked draft of the Anti-Counterfeiting Trade Agreement (ACTA). This action caused an instant public backlash. Activists worried the document contained rules that would heavily limit internet freedom and privacy. The leaked text indicated the agreement would require internet service providers to hand over customer data. It also suggested banning multi-region CD and DVD players. Because of these points, critics labeled the deal a 'Pirate Bay killer' that endangers digital rights."}
